title: Waiting for one particular drop
odia: ଗଂଗାଦି ନାନା ତୀର୍ଥ ନିକଟେ ଥାଇଣ ଚାତକ, ଜଳଦ ଜଳ ଟୋପେକୁ ଆଶ୍ରାକରି ଅବିରତେ ତୃଷୀକ
literal_meaning: Near the Ganga and other sacred waters, the chataka remains thirsty, depending on a drop from a cloud.
explanation: The verse pictures longing fixed on one source despite alternatives nearby. It may evoke steadfast desire; context determines whether that seems admirable or impractical.
meaning_odia: ପାଖରେ ଅନ୍ୟ ସୁଯୋଗ ଥିଲେ ବି ମନ ଗୋଟିଏ ଆଶାରେ ଅଟକି ରହେ; ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗ ଅନୁସାରେ ଏହା ନିଷ୍ଠା ବା ଅବ୍ୟବହାରିକ ଅପେକ୍ଷା ଲାଗିପାରେ।
usage_example: A musician declines several engagements while waiting for the invitation that matters most to them. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: Read as a literary bird-image, not a claim about a species’ drinking habits. The page names no author or originating work.
